items.description: The SEO Audit tool from SEO Review Tools, utilizes the power of Ahrefs, SEMrush and MOZ to present you with a full website SEO audit in just 15 seconds. Data returned by this tool include: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Search volume and Backlink count. After entering your URL, this tool will analyse your website based on 21 different data points.
Automate your SEO reporting in Excel without programming.
Enthusem is a service that allows users to send physical greeting cards online. Through its integration with Box.net, users can send cards containing content from their Box.net files.
This mashup allows Box.net users to create physical mailers directly from their Box accounts using pictures they have stored.
ContractsForGeeks is an employment search tool that sources the indeed API to find job postings, then arranges them by city or state. It also includes and IT recruiter directory.
CareSteps – Robust, Paperless Business Solutions it provides versatile and paperless mobile business solutions that reduce your business cost and improve online market visibility. Go paperless today!

ESCNostalgia allows you to rediscover past events of the Eurovision Song Contest (ESC). Listen to and view all results and performances of ESC from 1957 until today. The website is integrated with Spotify so you can listen to the songs and Youtube to view videos of the performances.

ChumpDump is a new twist on twitter, a game that rewards players for weeding the chumps out of their twitter feed. Data from that game is presented here on ChumpDar, who got dumped on twitter and why. Playable on Android and iPhone.
Links you to pizzeria reviews at America’s Favorite Pizza Weblog. With fun slice-shaped map markers.

View tweets on Google Earth. This Google Earth plug-in allows you to navigate and explore geographic data on a 3D globe using a web browser. The plug-in is also used on Earth view in Google Maps. If you want to embed the Google Earth plug-in on your website, visit the Google Earth API site to learn more.
A Google Maps mashup that allows you to mark places of interest, add reviews, and share your favorite locations with others.
Import Basecamp time in to QuickBooks.
FoxyMap is a Google Gadget which allows you to monitor the locations of speed traps. Those locations are set via mobile tagging by the users of the mobile application FoxyTag.
Plot future and past trips on a map. Control trip colours, curves, transport modes.
Presenting vintage photos from Flickr in an interesting way.

Sunday Morning Rides is an interactive community portal for motorcycle riders to access, explore, plan, and share motorcycle tracks via a ride mapping system that combines GPS, geographic information systems, database, and Google mapping technologies.
Measures the distance between two locations.
A bookmarklet makes easier to design your twitter theme.
Using an integration of the Google Maps API and TRAFFY developed by NECTEC, this app shows realtime traffic information in Bangkok.

The website historicplaces.net was created in 2012 as a comprehensive listing of buildings, structures, objects, and sites in North America that have received a special status based on their historical or archaeological significance. We have almost 100.000 historic places listed in our database.

Mesibo is a real-time chat app for your business or personal communication and also provides APIs that lets you build real-time chat messaging, voice, and video calls in your mobile apps and websites in just a few hours. Mesibo SDK underpins the complexities of messaging not only by providing a cross-platform API, ready to use UI but also a solid, scalable carrier-grade platform built from the ground-up to support millions of concurrent calls & messaging with low latency & high reliability.
Thank to Wikipedia, descriptions of cities are embedded into description box. At the end of the content there's a backlink pointing to the source.

moTube is a mobile subscription service that allows people to receive notifications via text message (SMS/MMS) each time a new video is published to a YouTube channel. We created moTube as a way for people to get realtime updates from their favorite YouTube channels directly on their phone. It's a free service and we don't charge subscribers for the notifications sent to their device. Keep in mind that the text messaging plan you have with your mobile carrier still applies. For example, if you have an unlimited messaging plan and receive an update from moTube, you will not be charged anything. moTube is currently in beta, so YouTubers who want to add moTube to their channel must have an invite which we're currently accepting requests for on our website (http://motube.us/).

Consolidation of information about notable people, including celebrities, musicians, writers, historical figures and sports people. Auto-ranking of people based on density of current news and automatic analysis of connections between people.

A prediction market for Amazon products. Each new product added becomes a stock. If a product's Amazon's sales rank improves, its stock price goes up. And vice-versa. Traders buy, sell, short, and cover.
Wide collection of Arabic media including TV, radio, movies and clips.
Chronologically and geographically, map the events of World War Two.
A new experimental way to explore the Ile-de-France railway public transit system based on NAViTiA public transport information system API.
SharedBook used its API and Google widgets to build Blog2Print, a new blog printing widget that can be used by writers and their readers to turn blog posts into books.
Lets people know the best way to get from A to B in Dublin using just the public transportation. Access over 5000 stops, with more coming. Also available in multiple languages.
GeoImpress provides a completely new way to search for places all over the world. Integrates Google Maps, Flickr, and Twitter.
Map of the tastest growing American states as being reported by Fortune magazine.
Tweet Awards is a collection of the best greek tweets.
Simple surveys to share with friends through Twitter, sms or email. Anywhere you can paste text, you can give a wedgie (a simple survey).
Simply text #selection to see it appearing on the web page in real time!
Textmob allows anyone to easily create an SMS group around a trip or event. Send the SMS group to friends and they can join the group also.
Let Santa Call makes phone calls to your friends, and play them a Christmas song.

Helps users find RSS feeds and autogenerates OPML files. Uses Windows Live Search API. Facilitates selecting feeds from root weblogs or comments feeds per user selection with support for international markets.
A bookmarking site for submitting your favorite links. Others can add links or simply vote for the link.
We all have people in our lives we'd like to talk to more often. Stay In Touch is a simple app that helps you prioritize and stay connected to the family and friends you care about.
Very unique mashup that allows you track any of dozens of satellites in realtime as they circle the earth. Watch them move across the top of Google Maps. Lots of peripheral details as well.

MyApartmentMap is an apartment search engine that allows users to find apartment listings all over the United States. Searchers can view pictures, maps, rental data, find deals, post rentals and contact property owners. MyApartmentMap also has specific search features for college students, pet owners, and military families.
Displays Amtrak rail routes and stations on Google Maps.

iTavli by iSmart Solutions is a backgammon game mashup. The objective of each game is to transfer the chips (or checkers) from the base area to the collecting area. Each game has different rules that the players need to follow.
